title: Vanity Top Accessorie Toilet Tissue Holder Solid Brass Countertop 6-Inch Height | Allied Brass
description:
Add convenient toilet paper storage to your bathroom vanity with this vanity top accessorie toilet tissue holder. The countertop toilet paper holder / freestanding toilet tissue stand is made from solid brass and uses a weighted base to help prevent tipping—ideal when wall space is limited.

Highlights:
- Solid brass construction
- Weighted base helps prevent tipping
- Space-saving vanity/countertop design for bathrooms
- Felt pad helps prevent scratching on surfaces
- Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement colors

Specs:
- Mounting type: Countertop
- Dimensions: 5.5-Inch L x 5-Inch W x 6-Inch H
- Weight: 4 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included: Vanity Top Toilet Tissue Holder
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Style notes:
- Designed to coordinate with modern bathroom hardware and contemporary bath accessories; a clean fit for minimalist bathroom fixtures.
